messages.author: 671b14edc9322fa7
messages.subject: Re: R square
parts:
Hi

Intent is not used as dependent variable in any of the model equations and therefore does not have an R2. 

If you want to use intent as a DV, you need to write the latent variable regressions as 

intent ~ attant + attdia + subj + control + severity + suscep

(This probably what you wanted to do in the first place.)

Mikko

messages.subject: RE: R square
parts:
Fiona—

     I see that “intent” is a predictor factor.  R2 is the proportion of a dependent variable’s variance that is accounted for by other variables.  Are you looking for something else, like the variance that a predictor variable accounts for?

--Ed Rigdon
